How much an average character's bladder holds, in milliliters. Small and Large Bladder scale this per character.
How much an average character's bowels hold, in milliliters. Small and Large Bowels scale this per character.
Whether awake characters can urinate themselves, from a full bladder, an urge or incontinence.
Whether awake characters can defecate themselves, from a full bowel, an urge or incontinence.
Peeing on the ground leaves a urine puddle.
Multiplies how long defecating takes. Higher is slower, 0 is as fast as possible.
Whether defecation traits can be picked in character creation. Turning this off also stops them working on existing characters.
Turns the whole defecation system on or off. When off, the bowels stay empty, the menu options are hidden and defecation traits are unavailable.
Food sickness makes the bowels fill faster, up to five times the normal rate.
Whether urination traits can be picked in character creation. Turning this off also stops them working on existing characters.
Turns the whole urination system on or off. When off, the bladder stays empty, the menu options are hidden and urination traits are unavailable.
Flies gather around nearby feces, with sound.
Whether sleeping characters can urinate themselves. Requires the Bedwetter trait or incontinence. A full bladder still wakes them.
Whether sleeping characters can defecate themselves. Requires the Bedsoiler trait or incontinence. A full bowel still wakes them.
Bladder fullness to pee in container.
Bladder fullness to pee in toilet.
Bladder fullness to pee on ground.
Bladder fullness to intentionally pee self.
Bowel fullness to poop in toilet.
Bowel fullness to poop on ground.
Bowel fullness to intentionally poop self.
Chance that a full visit to a flushed toilet clogs it. A visit cut short has a smaller chance.
Chance that flushing a clogged toilet overflows, leaving a sewage puddle around it. The flush never works while the toilet is clogged.
A flushing toilet can only be used while its tank holds enough water for a flush. Without running water it has to be refilled, for example from a rain collector.
Toilets get a small container. Poop and used wipes go in it, and flushing removes them. Toilets that already have one keep it if this is turned off.
These are features that don't currently exist, but are planned.
Clothes come off where the character is standing, then they walk to the toilet. Nothing clips, but they cross the room with their trousers down.
The character walks over, undresses standing at the toilet, then sits. No walking around undressed and no clipping through the seat.
The character sits first and then undresses, which means standing back up mid-animation and clipping through the toilet.
Controls where in the sequence clothing comes off when walking to a toilet, outhouse, sink or bush. Does not affect relieving yourself on the spot, where there is no walk.
Chance that a full visit clogs a toilet that still has something in it from an earlier visit.
How many times a toilet can be used before it has to be flushed. A visit cut short still counts once.
Multiplies the chance that an urge wave turns into an accident. 0 means urge waves never cause accidents. Overflowing still does.
How often a full bladder or bowel sends a sudden wave of urgency that makes the character stop and hold on. 0 turns urge waves off.
Multiplies how long urinating takes. Higher is slower, 0 is as fast as possible.
Show urine stain on wet clothing.
Show fecal stain on soiled clothing.
Reduce bowel value by 10% of max per pill.
Reduce bladder value by 10% of max per pill.
Increase bladder value by 20% of max per pill.
Increase bowel value by 20% of max per pill.
What you want the bladder / bowel moodle types to be based on.
Show options for peeing in containers in the context menu.
Show option for peeing yourself in the context menu.
Whether to announce player status above their head (ex. 'I've peed myself.').
Show option for pooping yourself in the context menu.
Puts the options to pee or poop in a toilet or sink in that toilet's or sink's own right-click menu. When off, they are in the Urinate and Defecate menus with the other options.
Whether to show basic peeing and pooping moodles.
Whether to show peed and pooped self moodles.
Bodily functions panel with all detailed values available.
Bladder holds a quarter more, so you can wait longer between trips.
Bowels hold a quarter more, so you can wait longer between trips.
Half as likely to lose control during an urge, and 75% chance to stop urination 5% of the way through peeing self.
Half as likely to lose control during an urge, and 75% chance to stop defecation 5% of the way through pooping self.
Defecation is difficult when near zombies or players.
Urination is difficult when near zombies or players.
Urination is difficult without using the toilet.
Defecation is difficult without using the toilet.
Bladder holds a quarter less, so you need to go sooner and more often.
Bowels hold a quarter less, so you need to go sooner and more often.
